resources.string: Locks the apps you choose behind your fingerprint, face, or screen lock

Bio Key uses this service to see which app is in the foreground, so it can cover apps you\'ve chosen to lock until you authenticate. It also recognises Bio Key\'s own App info, accessibility, and uninstall screens so that switching Bio Key off requires your authentication.\n\nBio Key does not read what you type, does not record the screen, and has no internet access. Nothing it observes leaves your device.

Makes uninstalling Bio Key a two-step process that requires your authentication. If intruder photos are enabled, it is also notified of failed screen unlocks. Bio Key cannot lock, wipe, or change anything on your device through this permission.
